title: Overheat / High Limit
shortDescription: Baxi Luna or EcoBlue tripped on high temperature.
fullDescription:
E110 indicates the supply overheat thermostat opened. Air in the HX, low pressure, or failed pump are typical.

Reset by cycling the mains and re-pressurising to 1-1.5 bar. Repeat trips are not normal.
safetyWarning: Do not bypass the overheat thermostat.

fixSteps.title: Pressurise to 1.2 bar
fixSteps.instruction: Use the filling loop to top up to 1.2 bar cold.

fixSteps.title: Bleed radiators
fixSteps.instruction: Bleed all radiators starting with the lowest level.

whenToCallPro: Gas-Safe engineer for HX scale removal.

faq.q: Why does it trip after a holiday?
faq.a: Air collects when standing — bleed and refill.

title: Low Water Pressure
fullDescription:
E118 is the classic Baxi low-pressure code on Luna, EcoBlue, and Platinum models. Pressure must be between 1.0-2.0 bar cold for normal operation.

Use the filling loop or filling key to top up. If you cannot keep pressure for more than a week there is a leak.
safetyWarning: Do not exceed 2.5 bar — the PRV will open.

fixSteps.title: Top up via filling loop
fixSteps.instruction: Open both valves of the filling loop until 1.2 bar; close.

fixSteps.title: Look for leaks
fixSteps.instruction: Check radiator vents, valves, and PRV pipe outside.

whenToCallPro: Hidden leak or expansion vessel work.

faq.a: Once a year is normal; weekly means a leak.

title: Circulation Fault
fullDescription:
E125 is a circulation/flow fault — the rate of temperature rise indicates flow is below threshold. Common causes are a stuck pump, closed isolation valves, or sludge in the system.

A full power-flush is often required on older systems showing repeat E125.
safetyWarning: Repeated E125 with high HX temps can damage the heat exchanger.

fixSteps.title: Verify isolation
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm both flow and return service valves under the boiler are open.

fixSteps.title: Free pump
fixSteps.instruction: If access permits, free the pump shaft with a screwdriver in the central slot.

whenToCallPro: Power flush and HX clean.

faq.a: Yes — fitting one prevents sludge buildup.

title: Ignition Failure
fullDescription:
E133 is the Baxi ignition lockout. Three failed retries put the boiler into lockout pending reset.

Check gas supply — many UK households see E133 right after a meter or supply interruption.
safetyWarning: Gas appliance — if you smell gas, evacuate and call 0800 111 999 (UK).

fixSteps.title: Verify gas supply
fixSteps.instruction: Check that another gas appliance (cooker) lights normally.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Press Reset.

whenToCallPro: Gas Safe engineer for pressure verification.

faq.a: Yes — air in the line; the engineer should re-bleed.

title: Fan Fault
shortDescription: Combustion fan RPM out of range.
fullDescription: E160 indicates the fan tach feedback does not match the commanded speed. Check the fan harness, impeller, and motor.
safetyWarning: Disconnect mains before fan work.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat the fan PWM and tach connectors.

whenToCallPro: Fan replacement.

faq.a: No, sealed-combustion mandatory.

title: PCB / Generic Fault
fullDescription:
E168 is a catch-all PCB fault on Baxi Luna and EcoBlue. The control failed an internal self-check. Often follows surge events or moisture intrusion.

A single occurrence may clear with a power cycle; persistent E168 needs PCB replacement.
safetyWarning: Isolate mains before opening the control compartment.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Off at the spur for 2 minutes.

whenToCallPro: Always for PCB work.

faq.a: Yes — fit a surge protector.

title: Pressure Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Pressure transducer signal out of range.
fullDescription: E119 means the pressure transducer is reading invalid values. Check the connector and the small pipe to the transducer for water staining.
safetyWarning: Power off before sensor work.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat transducer connector.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Swap the OEM transducer.

whenToCallPro: If draining is required.

faq.a: Sensor signal is bad, not the actual pressure.

title: Flue Sensor / Vent Fault
fullDescription: E131 covers the flue NTC. Required to limit firing rate for safe vent temperatures.
safetyWarning: Do not bypass.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connector
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat sensor harness.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Swap OEM.

whenToCallPro: If gasket reset on flue collector required.

faq.a: Constant condensate exposure ages the NTC.

title: High Pressure
fullDescription: E117 means too much pressure in the system. Often the filling loop has been left open or the expansion vessel is waterlogged.
safetyWarning: Above 3 bar the PRV will discharge.

fixSteps.title: Close filling loop
fixSteps.instruction: Verify both valves of the filling loop are closed.

fixSteps.title: Bleed to 1.2 bar
fixSteps.instruction: Bleed a radiator until gauge shows 1.2 bar.

whenToCallPro: Expansion vessel re-pressurization.

faq.a: Waterlogged expansion vessel — recharge or replace.

fullDescription: E151 is another PCB fault similar to E168, common on Luna and EcoBlue platforms. PCB replacement is usually required.

faq.a: Usually yes — but for older units consider replacement.

title: DHW Flow Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Domestic hot water flow turbine signal abnormal.
fullDescription:
Fault E18 on Baxi combi boilers indicates the DHW flow turbine is not producing the expected signal when hot water is drawn. The boiler may show DHW outage or temperature swings.

Common causes are debris in the flow turbine, scale buildup, or a failed sensor.
safetyWarning: This error involves a gas-fired appliance. If you smell gas at any time, do not operate switches or attempt repairs. Evacuate, leave doors open, and call your gas utility from a safe location. Repairs to gas valves, burners, or flue components must be performed by a licensed gas engineer or technician.
symptoms: Boiler will not light for DHW

fixSteps.title: Engineer Inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer isolates water and inspects the flow turbine.

fixSteps.title: Clean or Replace

whenToCallPro: If cleaning the turbine does not resolve the code, the sensor must be replaced.

title: Heating Flow Sensor (NTC1) Fault
shortDescription: Heating flow temperature sensor reading out of range.
fullDescription: Fault E19 indicates the heating flow NTC is open or shorted. The Baxi boiler will lock out heating until the sensor is restored.
safetyWarning: This error involves a gas-fired appliance. If you smell gas at any time, do not operate switches or attempt repairs. Evacuate, leave doors open, and call your gas utility from a safe location. Repairs to gas valves, burners, or flue components must be performed by a licensed gas engineer or technician.

fixSteps.title: Reseat Sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Power off; reseat the NTC connector.

fixSteps.title: Replace NTC
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer replaces the NTC if testing confirms failure.

whenToCallPro: If reseating the connector does not clear the code, have an engineer replace the NTC.

faq.a: It is a safety lockout. The boiler is preventing operation without valid temperature data.

title: Ionisation / Flame Failure
fullDescription:
Fault E21 on Baxi combi/system boilers indicates the boiler attempted to ignite but did not establish a stable flame within the allowed window. Common causes include closed gas valve, blocked condensate trap (causing flame loss), dirty flame probe, or a failed gas valve.

If the unit was recently serviced, also confirm gas type DIP settings.
safetyWarning: This error involves a gas-fired appliance. If you smell gas at any time, do not operate switches or attempt repairs. Evacuate, leave doors open, and call your gas utility from a safe location. Repairs to gas valves, burners, or flue components must be performed by a licensed gas engineer or technician.

fixSteps.title: Verify Gas
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm gas service cock is open and other gas appliances work.

fixSteps.title: Clear Condensate
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer clears and refills the condensate trap.

fixSteps.title: Engineer Diagnosis
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer cleans flame probe and verifies gas pressure with a manometer.

whenToCallPro: If gas is verified and the condensate trap is clear, a Gas Safe engineer must inspect the burner and gas valve.

faq.q: Can a frozen condensate cause E21?
faq.a: Yes. A blocked or frozen condensate trap will cause repeated flame loss; thaw and clear before retrying.

title: Low System Pressure
shortDescription: System pressure below the minimum operating threshold.
fullDescription: Fault E22 on certain Baxi models indicates system pressure has fallen below the boiler's working minimum (commonly 0.5-0.8 bar). Top up via the filling loop and inspect for leaks.
safetyWarning: This error involves a gas-fired appliance. If you smell gas at any time, do not operate switches or attempt repairs. Evacuate, leave doors open, and call your gas utility from a safe location. Repairs to gas valves, burners, or flue components must be performed by a licensed gas engineer or technician.

fixSteps.title: Top Up
fixSteps.instruction: Use the filling loop to bring pressure to 1.0-1.5 bar cold.

fixSteps.title: Inspect for Leaks
fixSteps.instruction: Check joints, valves, and PRV outside discharge for moisture.

fixSteps.title: Engineer Service
fixSteps.instruction: If pressure drops repeatedly, engineer tests expansion vessel charge.

whenToCallPro: Repeated low pressure events should be investigated by a Gas Safe engineer.

faq.a: Avoid frequent top-ups; oxygen-rich water accelerates corrosion. Find and fix the leak.

title: Fan Speed Out of Range
shortDescription: Combustion fan RPM does not match the commanded value.
fullDescription: Fault E26 on Baxi boilers indicates the fan is failing to reach or hold the required RPM. Causes include worn fan motor, blocked vent, or a fan harness issue.
safetyWarning: This error involves a gas-fired appliance. If you smell gas at any time, do not operate switches or attempt repairs. Evacuate, leave doors open, and call your gas utility from a safe location. Repairs to gas valves, burners, or flue components must be performed by a licensed gas engineer or technician.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Flue
fixSteps.instruction: Verify intake/exhaust terminations are clear and flue length within spec.

fixSteps.title: Replace Fan
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer replaces fan and verifies combustion with a flue gas analyzer.

whenToCallPro: Fan replacement requires re-verifying combustion CO/CO2; have a Gas Safe engineer perform the work.

faq.q: Why does E26 happen on cold days?
faq.a: Iced flue terminations restrict airflow; clear ice and verify slope to drain.

title: Condensate Drain Blocked
shortDescription: Condensate trap pressure switch indicates blockage or freezing.
fullDescription:
Fault E27 on Baxi boilers indicates the condensate path is blocked. Frozen condensate in winter is the most common cause; sludge or biological growth is the second.

Thaw with warm (not boiling) water and verify the run slopes continuously to drain.
safetyWarning: This error involves a gas-fired appliance. If you smell gas at any time, do not operate switches or attempt repairs. Evacuate, leave doors open, and call your gas utility from a safe location. Repairs to gas valves, burners, or flue components must be performed by a licensed gas engineer or technician.

fixSteps.title: Thaw Pipe
fixSteps.instruction: Apply warm water along the external condensate run; reset boiler once thawed.

fixSteps.title: Clean Trap
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer removes and cleans the condensate trap, refills with water before reinstall.

fixSteps.title: Insulate Run
fixSteps.instruction: Insulate any external condensate pipe with weatherproof lagging or relocate inside.

whenToCallPro: Persistent E27 in summer suggests a sludged trap; have an engineer perform a full clean.

faq.q: Can I pour boiling water on a frozen pipe?
faq.a: No. Use warm water or a wrapped hot-water bottle to avoid cracking the pipe.

title: Flue Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Flue gas thermistor open or shorted.
fullDescription: Fault E28 indicates the flue gas NTC is reading out of range. The boiler protects the plastic flue components from over-temperature using this sensor and will lock out if the signal is invalid.
safetyWarning: This error involves a gas-fired appliance. If you smell gas at any time, do not operate switches or attempt repairs. Evacuate, leave doors open, and call your gas utility from a safe location. Repairs to gas valves, burners, or flue components must be performed by a licensed gas engineer or technician.

fixSteps.title: Engineer Inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer inspects flue NTC at the elbow and tests resistance.

fixSteps.title: Replace Sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Replace if out of spec.

whenToCallPro: Sensor work near the flue should be done by a Gas Safe engineer.

faq.q: Could a recent overheat cause E28?
faq.a: Yes; high flue gas temperatures can damage the NTC. Inspect the heat exchanger for scale at the same time.

title: Limescale / Scale Detected
shortDescription: Boiler self-test detects abnormal heat transfer rate consistent with scale.
fullDescription:
Fault E32 on Baxi combi boilers indicates the boiler has detected a slow temperature rise rate during DHW operation, suggesting scale buildup in the DHW heat exchanger. The boiler may continue to operate at reduced output, but flow rate and efficiency suffer.

A full descaling is required.
safetyWarning: This error involves a gas-fired appliance. If you smell gas at any time, do not operate switches or attempt repairs. Evacuate, leave doors open, and call your gas utility from a safe location. Repairs to gas valves, burners, or flue components must be performed by a licensed gas engineer or technician.

causes.cause: Scale buildup in plate heat exchanger

fixSteps.title: Descale Plate Exchanger
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer isolates DHW side and circulates a Baxi-approved descaler for 60-90 minutes; then flush thoroughly.

fixSteps.title: Install Scale Reducer
fixSteps.instruction: Consider installing a scale reducer or softener on incoming cold supply.

whenToCallPro: Scale work should be performed by a qualified engineer to avoid damaging seals or contaminating system water.

faq.a: Hard-water areas: annually. Soft-water: every 3-5 years.

title: Gas Valve Fault
fullDescription: Fault E55 on Baxi boilers indicates the PCB has detected an abnormal feedback signal from the modulating gas valve. The boiler will lock out before ignition.
safetyWarning: This error involves a gas-fired appliance. If you smell gas at any time, do not operate switches or attempt repairs. Evacuate, leave doors open, and call your gas utility from a safe location. Repairs to gas valves, burners, or flue components must be performed by a licensed gas engineer or technician.

fixSteps.title: Engineer Inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer measures coil resistance and inspects harness.

fixSteps.title: Replace Gas Valve
fixSteps.instruction: Replace gas valve, leak test, verify combustion.

whenToCallPro: Gas valve faults must be diagnosed by a Gas Safe engineer.

faq.a: No. Repeated resets on a gas valve fault are unsafe.

title: Flame Stabilisation Time Exceeded
shortDescription: Flame did not stabilise within the allowed window after ignition.
fullDescription: Fault E62 indicates the burner ignited but the flame ionisation signal did not stabilise within the allowed time. Causes include a dirty flame probe, incorrect gas/air ratio, low gas pressure, or flue recirculation.
safetyWarning: This error involves a gas-fired appliance. If you smell gas at any time, do not operate switches or attempt repairs. Evacuate, leave doors open, and call your gas utility from a safe location. Repairs to gas valves, burners, or flue components must be performed by a licensed gas engineer or technician.

fixSteps.title: Engineer Service
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer cleans flame probe and verifies gas pressure and CO2.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Flue
fixSteps.instruction: Verify flue assembly and intake to rule out recirculation.

whenToCallPro: All combustion-related faults must be handled by a Gas Safe engineer with a calibrated flue gas analyzer.

faq.q: Will cleaning the burner solve E62?
faq.a: Sometimes. After any burner-side work, combustion settings must be re-verified.
